current_scoring_authority.scope_note: The existing bounded scientific scope is retained.
current_scoring_authority.historical_record_role: Historical/source records are non-scoring provenance. Deleted outcomes and old thresholds are not acceptance requirements; no historical scientific pass is inherited.

items.statement: Carbonyl-function dependence of productive capture and electrochemical behavior
items.expected: Explain the secondary ketone/ester/methyl-Weinreb-amide versus aldehyde/acid substitution contrast using genuine comparable electronic calculations on the correct identities, and relate the result to the given voltammetry. The source radical-cation route gives greater alpha-carbon electrophilic character for ketone/ester/amide than aldehyde/acid; compatible alternative molecular evidence passes directly. Report numerical descriptors and define the modeled states. Establish why a near-contact geometry or electrochemical reversibility alone does not guarantee productive benzoate capture; do not demand a monotonic82/70/44 yield law or equate charges with rates. Distinguish E1/2 from irreversible Ep/2 and an observed return peak from proof of a unique decomposition pathway.

items.statement: How the Weinreb-amide side chain changes molecular organization and reaction compatibility
items.expected: Use actual methyl/butyl-Weinreb-amide calculations to explain their different reaction behavior through a supported change in molecular organization and electronic response. The source route links a close-contact, backbone-delocalized methyl state to a preferred distal, more nitrogen-localized butyl state, with a higher-G close-contact conformer for the same butyl identity (source+2.5kcal/mol, no hard window). Report quantitative structural/electronic comparisons and any conformational free-energy comparison used. These are supporting evidence for the single side-chain conclusion, not independently scored author nodes. Equivalent well-supported physical explanations pass. Do not call a conformer penalty a HAT barrier or infer a proven1,5/1,6-HAT product network from irreversible CV. The butyl case lacks the aldehyde/acid return-peak feature and must not be assigned the same proven fate.

items.statement: Why electrochemical persistence and primary/secondary capture efficiency can differ
items.expected: Use a genuine primary/secondary ketone electronic comparison to explain why similar electrochemical persistence need not imply similar benzoate-capture efficiency. Reference radical-cation alpha-carbon charge is more negative for the primary graph (SI S19, mainS14) than the secondary ketone (S1), supporting reduced nucleophilic capture compatibility; physically equivalent validated evidence passes directly. Give the numerical comparison and its model definition. Preserve the primaryDCM/crude-NMR versus secondaryMeCN/isolated-yield condition difference; no matched-condition exact yield ratio, stereochemical prediction or unique full mechanism follows. Merely restating12% versus82% fails.

historical_non_scoring_items.statement: 可反应与较差羰基体系存在局部电子差异
historical_non_scoring_items.expected: 对所给酮/酯/Weinreb酰胺与醛/酸体系的实际分子比较支持与亲核捕获相关的局部电子差异。作者参考为S1/S3/S5的C3正电性相对S7/S8较高；允许定义相容、支持同一分子反应性差异的其他电子证据。不能只排列实验收率或把电荷直接当活化能。

historical_non_scoring_items.statement: 丁基侧链改变近接与远离构象
historical_non_scoring_items.expected: 实际结构比较支持甲基Weinreb酰胺的近接组织与丁基S6最低构象的远离组织存在差别，并保持同一分子身份和正确原子映射。作者S5近接、S6-c1远离为参考；不强设统一几何截断，也不以替换底物或未经优化的示意图得分。

historical_non_scoring_items.statement: 侧链相关构象差异伴随自旋分布变化
historical_non_scoring_items.expected: 实际电子分析支持近接组织的自旋更沿底物骨架离域，而S6远离构象相对更集中在含氮中心；必须将分布对应到有效构型，而非只列总S²或说是自由基。可接受物理等价的电子分布分析；不要求特定NBO版本或未定义的负键能列。

historical_non_scoring_items.statement: S6近接构象相对远离构象需付出自由能
historical_non_scoring_items.expected: 对同一S6身份的两个有效构象比较，得到近接c2相对远离c1不利的溶液G差。作者+2.5 kcal/mol为上下文，重点是可比定义与方向；不得以跨分子绝对能差或约束扫描未优化帧代替构象G，也不能将该差当HAT势垒。
